items.title: Michael Porter Jr. Explains What Went WRONG With Cam Thomas in Brooklyn
items.author: Road Trippin' Show
items.body_excerpt: Michael Porter Jr. shares his perspective on Cam Thomas’ time in Brooklyn, from elite shot-making to the leadership and communication expected of a top option. MPJ also explains why being quiet should not automatically be mistaken for being a bad teammate. Recorded May 6, 2026.…
